reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount used by all server sites, but re-derives the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts that matching uses.

duplication.why: `Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075)` duplicates getApproxNumberThreshold, so the matching tolerance and the planning tolerance can drift apart.

placement.why: The rule is in shared/schedules.ts with the range rule; the op is threaded from each caller, which is where the tree keeps the condition operator.

scope.why: Only the helper, its server call sites, comments and tests.

maintainability.why: An optional positional amountOp after a boolean forces `false` placeholders at every call, and callers that omit the op (client SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile lists) silently get the old exact-value behaviour.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount recomputes the approx tolerance instead of using getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula of getApproxNumberThreshold is rewritten inline (with Math.sign) inside getScheduledAmount rather than called.

one_place.where: The rule is defined in getScheduledAmount, but it only applies when the caller passes amountOp; the server paths do, while client callers of the same helper (desktop-client Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, mobile SchedulesListItem/MobileSchedulesPage) do not, and the tolerance itself is a second copy of getApproxNumberThreshold.
